item.title: Working capital grants for regional airlines
item.description: The Regional Infrastructure Fund will provide funding to help regional airlines manage the operating pressures facing the sector.

item.title: Land secured for South Auckland hospital
item.description: Land has been secured for a future hospital facility on Karaka Road in Drury, marking a significant investment in the long-term healthcare needs of South Auckland's growing population.

item.title: Pharmacies to provide more funded medicines
item.description: Pharmac and Health New Zealand are increasing the number of funded medicines community pharmacies can provide from today, Associate Health Minister David Seymour and Health Minister Simeon Brown say.

item.title: Government progresses plan changes to enable growth for New Plymouth
item.description: Targeted changes to New Plymouth’s District Plan will make it easier for homeowners and developers to build, alter homes, and make better use of land, while removing unnecessary consenting requirements and other planning barriers to growth.

item.title: Next steps for Nelson Tasman weather radar
item.description: Nelson Tasman communities are one step closer to more timely and accurate weather information, with a site selected for the region’s new weather radar.

item.title: Beekeepers get more certainty on American foulbrood management
item.description: The Government is progressing long-signalled updates to the National American Foulbrood Pest Management Plan, based on proposals developed and consulted on by the beekeeping industry.

item.title: Tasman SH60 intersection improvement underway
item.description: The Government is progressing important safety improvements to a key Tasman State Highway intersection, following community concern after multiple crashes.

item.title: Government support for weather-hit Southland and Clutha farmers
item.description: Agriculture Minister Todd McClay and Rural Communities Minister Mark Patterson have today classified the extreme wet and cold conditions across Southland and the Clutha District as a medium-scale adverse event.

item.title: New explorer seeks second petroleum permit
item.description: Enzed Energy, the first explorer to be awarded a new petroleum exploration permit since the repeal of the offshore exploration ban, has lodged a second application targeting the promising Toutouwai prospect in the offshore Taranaki Basin.

item.title: New ACOPs clarify health and safety responsibilities on farms
item.description: Workplace Relations and Safety Minister Brooke van Velden today launched two new Approved Codes of Practice [ACOP] that outline practical steps businesses and workers can take to meet their health and safety responsibilities on farms.

item.title: Patient community helps improve access to paediatric cancer medicines for young Kiwis
item.description: Associate Health Minister David Seymour and Health Minister Simeon Brown have today welcomed Pharmac’s decision to expand access to funded cancer treatments for adolescents and young adults with paediatric-origin cancers.
